name: Tahsin Industrial Corporation
summary: Tahsin Industrial Corporation manufactures and trades rainwear, garments, furniture products, office equipment, and corrugated boards in Taiwan. The company offers plastic and nylon raincoats, wardrobes, nylon jackets, PP corrugated boards, TC garments, leather goods, handbags, file folders, plastic film, carrier bags and laminating machines, etc. It also provides office equipment, including punching and binding machines, and laminators. In addition, the company trades in artificial leather, other synthetic resins, and various fiber products; and fabrics, clothing, shoes, caps, umbrellas, and apparel.
